hero.title: Custom software built around *how your business actually works.*
hero.text: We design and build web apps, portals, SaaS platforms and mobile apps for education, finance and marketing teams across Canada — and we stay on after launch.

teckhub.label: Our own product
teckhub.title: TeckHub*360*
teckhub.subtitle: The portal Canadian accounting firms *run filing season on.*
teckhub.text: After years of building client portals for Canadian practices one at a time, we built our own. Clients upload against a checklist, your team codes with OCR-suggested GIFI codes and files step by step — with payroll, invoices, deadlines and secure chat in the same place, under your firm's branding.

intro.title: Software that fits your business, *not the other way around.*
paragraphs: Off-the-shelf tools make your team change how it works to suit the software. We do the opposite: we learn the way your business already runs, build around it, then make it faster.
Strategy, UX/UI, development, deployment and ongoing support — one team, from the first conversation to years after launch.
